meta.title: Letter of Award / ARN: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role on the specified Enterprise tenant
Attempt Letter of Award / ARN generation and verify that NFA generation is refused or unavailable for the non-Buyer
Repeat the action as a Buyer and verify that NFA generation is available
Verify the generated NFA uses the organisation's format
Compare the two role outcomes while accounting for tenant RBAC configuration
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role on the specified Enterprise tenant; Attempt Letter of Award / ARN generation and verify that NFA generation is refused or unavailable for the non-Buyer; Repeat the action as a Buyer and verify that NFA generation is available; Verify the generated NFA uses the organisation's format; Compare the two role outcomes while accounting for tenant RBAC configuration

steps.note: Reach the proposal screen where the Letter of Award / ARN action is expected to be available.
Confirm the relevant proposal section is present before requesting the tester's role-specific comparison.

args.need: sign in as the non-Buyer user and then as a Buyer on the same Enterprise tenant, attempt Letter of Award / ARN NFA generation in each role, and report whether the action is refused or available and whether the generated NFA uses the organisation's format

steps.note: The catalog has no step for switching to these user roles or executing and comparing this role-protected action.
Keep a known assertion at the end of the plan for the proposal screen involved in the requested action.
